entities.summary: 1600 Smith Street is a 51-story, 732-foot (223 m) office tower in Downtown Houston, Texas, United States. It served as the headquarters of Continental Airlines prior to its merger with United Airlines in 2010, and at one point also served as the headquarters of ExpressJet Airlines. It is a part of the Cullen Center complex. 1600 Smith Street is a skyscraper from Americas, created circa 1984. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
